words.definition: The state of being real or existing
words.definationTranslation: Vaastavik ya maujood hone ka sthiti

sentence.sentence: The concept of existence is central to many philosophical debates.
sentence.translation: Astitva ka avdharana kayi daarshnik vivado mein kendriya hai.

sentence.sentence: The existence of a higher power is a topic of much speculation.
sentence.translation: Uchch shakti ka astitva bahut anumaan ka vishay hai.

words.definition: The state of things as they actually exist
words.definationTranslation: Cheezein jaise wah vaastav mein maujood hain

sentence.sentence: The reality of the situation was more complex than initially thought.
sentence.translation: Stithi ki vastavikta pahle soche se adhik jatil thi.

sentence.sentence: The reality of the world is often different from our perceptions.
sentence.translation: Duniya ki vastavikta aksar hamari soch se alag hoti hai.

words.definition: The branch of philosophy that deals with the nature of existence
words.definationTranslation: Darshan shastra ka ek shakha jo astitva ki prakriti se sambandhit hai

sentence.sentence: Ontology is a complex and abstract field of study.
sentence.translation: Astitva shastra ek jatil aur abhigya adhyayan ka kshetra hai.

sentence.sentence: The ontology of a particular theory can be difficult to understand.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh siddhant ki astitva shastra samajhna mushkil ho sakti hai.

words.definition: The study of conscious experience or perception
words.definationTranslation: Chetan anubhav ya pratyaksh ki adhyayan

sentence.sentence: Phenomenology is a key concept in understanding human consciousness.
sentence.translation: Anubhav vijnaan maanav chetna ko samajhne mein ek mahatvapoorn avdharana hai.

sentence.sentence: The phenomenology of a particular experience can be highly subjective.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh anubhav ki anubhav vijnaan atyant aatm-nirbhar ho sakti hai.

words.definition: The branch of philosophy that deals with the nature of knowledge
words.definationTranslation: Darshan shastra ka ek shakha jo gyaan ki prakriti se sambandhit hai

sentence.sentence: Epistemology is a crucial aspect of understanding how we acquire knowledge.
sentence.translation: Gyaan shastra gyaan haasil karne ke tareeke ko samajhne ka ek mahatvapoorn pahaloo hai.

sentence.sentence: The epistemology of a particular field can influence how we interpret data.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh kshetra ki gyaan shastra data ko vyakhya karne ke tareeke ko prabhavit kar sakti hai.

words.definition: The branch of philosophy that deals with the nature of reality
words.definationTranslation: Darshan shastra ka ek shakha jo vastavikta ki prakriti se sambandhit hai

sentence.sentence: Metaphysics is a broad and complex field of study.
sentence.translation: Atidarshan ek vistrit aur jatil adhyayan ka kshetra hai.

sentence.sentence: The metaphysics of a particular theory can have far-reaching implications.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh siddhant ki atidarshan kee door-gaami parinaam ho sakte hain.

words.definition: The inherent or fundamental nature of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ki antarbhuti ya moolbhoot prakriti

sentence.sentence: The essence of a thing is what makes it what it is.
sentence.translation: Kisi cheez ki aatma wah hai jo use wah banaati hai.

sentence.sentence: The essence of human beings is often debated by philosophers.
sentence.translation: Maanav aatma ka vishay darshnikon ke beech aksar charcha mein hota hai.

words.definition: The state of being a specific individual or thing
words.definationTranslation: Kisi vishesh vyakti ya cheez hone ka sthiti

sentence.sentence: Identity is a complex concept that involves many factors.
sentence.translation: Pahchaan ek jatil avdharana hai jo kayi kaarakon ko shaamil karti hai.

sentence.sentence: The identity of a person is shaped by their experiences and relationships.
sentence.translation: Kisi vyakti ki pahchaan unke anubhavon aur sambandhon se prabhavit hoti hai.

words.definition: Something that exists as a separate unit or being
words.definationTranslation: Koi cheez jo alag ikai ya vastu ke roop mein maujood hai

sentence.sentence: The entity of a company is separate from its employees.
sentence.translation: Ek company ki vastu uske karmchaariyon se alag hai.

sentence.sentence: The entity of a living being is complex and multifaceted.
sentence.translation: Jeevit prani ki vastu jatil aur bahuaayami hoti hai.

words.definition: The underlying material or nature of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ki adharaatmak padarath ya prakriti

sentence.sentence: The substance of a thing is what gives it its properties.
sentence.translation: Kisi cheez ki padarath wah hai jo use uske gun pradaan karti hai.

sentence.sentence: The substance of a philosophical argument can be difficult to grasp.
sentence.translation: Kisi darshan shastra ke tark ki padarath ko samajhna mushkil ho sakta hai.

words.definition: A quality or feature of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ki gunvatta ya visheshta

sentence.sentence: The attribute of kindness is highly valued in many cultures.
sentence.translation: Dayaluta ki visheshat kayi sanskritiyon mein atyant maanyata prapt hai.

sentence.sentence: The attribute of intelligence is often associated with success.
sentence.translation: Buddhimatta ki visheshat aksar safalta se sambandhit hoti hai.

words.definition: A characteristic or attribute of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ki visheshta ya gunvatta

sentence.sentence: The property of a material can affect its performance.
sentence.translation: Kisi padarath ki visheshta uske pradarshan ko prabhavit kar sakti hai.

sentence.sentence: The property of a mathematical concept can be proven through theorems.
sentence.translation: Ganitiya avdharana ki visheshta upapadon ke madhyam se sidh ki ja sakti hai.

words.definition: A group or class of things that share common characteristics
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ke samuh ya varg jo samaan visheshtao ko saajha karte hain

sentence.sentence: The category of living things includes animals and plants.
sentence.translation: Jeevit cheezon ki shreni mein jaanwar aur paudhe shaamil hain.

sentence.sentence: The category of abstract concepts includes ideas and feelings.
sentence.translation: Abhigya avdharanaon ki shreni mein vichaar aur bhaavanaen shaamil hain.

words.definition: The science of classifying things into groups or categories
words.definationTranslation: Cheezon ko vargon ya shreniyon mein vargikaran ka vigyaan

sentence.sentence: Taxonomy is used in biology to classify living organisms.
sentence.translation: Vargikaran jeev vigyaan mein jeevit praniyon ko vargikaran ke liye upyog kiya jaata hai.

sentence.sentence: The taxonomy of a particular field can influence how we understand it.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh kshetra ka vargikaran hum usse kaise samajhte hain is par prabhav daal sakta hai.

words.definition: The process of grouping things into categories or classes
words.definationTranslation: Cheezon ko vargon ya shreniyon mein samuhit karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Classification is an important step in understanding complex systems.
sentence.translation: Vargikaran jatil pranaliyon ko samajhne ke liye ek mahatvapoorn charan hai.

sentence.sentence: The classification of a particular phenomenon can be influenced by cultural factors.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh prakaar ka vargikaran saanskritik kaarakon se prabhavit ho sakta hai.

words.definition: The theory and methodology of interpretation
words.definationTranslation: Vyaakhya ka siddhant aur takneek

sentence.sentence: Hermenutics is a complex and nuanced field of study.
sentence.translation: Arth vigyaan ek jatil aur saukshma adhyayan ka kshetra hai.

sentence.sentence: The hermeneutics of a particular text can be influenced by historical context.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh paath ka arth vigyaan aitihasik sandarbh se prabhavit ho sakta hai.

words.definition: The study of meaning in language
words.definationTranslation: Bhasha mein arth ka adhyayan

sentence.sentence: Semantics is a crucial aspect of understanding how language works.
sentence.translation: Arth shastra bhasha ko kaam kaise karti hai isse samajhne ka ek mahatvapoorn pahaloo hai.

sentence.sentence: The semantics of a particular word can be influenced by cultural context.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh shabd ka arth shastra saanskritik sandarbh se prabhavit ho sakta hai.

words.definition: The study of how language is used in context
words.definationTranslation: Bhasha ka sandarbh mein upayog ka adhyayan

sentence.sentence: Pragmatics is an important aspect of understanding how language functions.
sentence.translation: Upayog shastra bhasha kaise kaam karti hai isse samajhne ka ek mahatvapoorn pahaloo hai.

sentence.sentence: The pragmatics of a particular utterance can be influenced by social context.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh uchaar ka upayog shastra samajik sandarbh se prabhavit ho sakta hai.

words.definition: A systematic investigation or research
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyavasthit anveshan ya shodh

sentence.sentence: Inquiry is an essential part of the scientific method.
sentence.translation: Puchh-tachh vaigyanik vidi ka ek aavashyak ang hai.

sentence.sentence: The inquiry into the nature of reality is a fundamental question in philosophy.
sentence.translation: Vastavikta ki prakriti ke baare mein puchh-tachh darshan shastra ka ek moolbhoot prashn hai.

words.definition: A systematic and scientific approach to a field of study
words.definationTranslation: Kisi adhyayan ka kshetra ke liye ek vyavasthit aur vaigyanik drishtikon

sentence.sentence: Methodology is a crucial aspect of any research project.
sentence.translation: Tark vidhi kisi bhi shodh pariyojna ka ek mahatvapoorn pahaloo hai.

sentence.sentence: The methodology of a particular study can influence its findings.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh adhyayan ka tark vidhi uske nateejon ko prabhavit kar sakti hai.

words.definition: A framework or model for understanding a particular phenomenon
words.definationTranslation: Kisi vishesh prakaar ke liye ek aadharsh ya model

sentence.sentence: A paradigm shift can revolutionize our understanding of a particular field.
sentence.translation: Aadharsh parivartan kisi vishesh kshetra ke baare mein hamari samajh ko kranti la sakta hai.

sentence.sentence: The paradigm of a particular theory can influence its application.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh siddhant ka aadharsh uske upayog ko prabhavit kar sakta hai.

words.definition: A particular point of view or way of looking at something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ko dekhne ka ek vishesh drishtikon ya tareeka

sentence.sentence: A new perspective can help us understand a complex issue.
sentence.translation: Ek naya drishikon hamein jatil maamle ko samajhne mein madad kar sakta hai.

sentence.sentence: The perspective of a particular culture can influence its values.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh sanskriti ka drishikon uske moolyon ko prabhavit kar sakta hai.

words.definition: The circumstances or situation in which something exists or occurs
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ke astitva ya ghatna ke liye paristhitiyon ya sthiti

sentence.sentence: Context is crucial in understanding the meaning of a particular text.
sentence.translation: Sandarbh kisi vishesh paath ke arth ko samajhne ke liye aavashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: The context of a particular event can influence its interpretation.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh ghatna ka sandarbh uske vyakhya ko prabhavit kar sakta hai.

words.definition: The act of explaining or understanding the meaning of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ke arth ka samjhana ya samjhna

sentence.sentence: Interpretation is a crucial step in understanding complex texts.
sentence.translation: Vyakhya jatil paathon ko samajhne ke liye ek mahatvapoorn charan hai.

sentence.sentence: The interpretation of a particular phenomenon can be influenced by cultural factors.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh prakaar ki vyakhya saanskritik kaarakon se prabhavit ho sakti hai.

words.definition: The process of breaking down complex information into smaller parts
words.definationTranslation: Jatil jaankari ko chhoti-chhoti bhagon mein todne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Analysis is a crucial step in understanding complex systems.
sentence.translation: Vishleshana jatil pranaliyon ko samajhne ke liye ek mahatvapoorn charan hai.

sentence.sentence: The analysis of a particular data set can reveal important insights.
sentence.translation: Kisi vishesh data set ka vishleshana mahatvapoorn gyaan ko prakat kar sakta hai.
